text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur was playing an online match in 
a game she always plays, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Auto-aim, no-clip... Does that mean 
another new tool is going around?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“—No good. Can't really play around until 
things settle down.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's a waste of time. I'm going to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just usin' cheats doesn't make your brain 
work any faster. If I use the terrain to 
trap 'em...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Ha, if anything, this just clears my 
head. Just like programming, the method to 
reach the result is wide open. There are 
countless moves I can make.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Working through his tactical scheming, Air 
Shakur would go on to gain various 
insights that could later be utilized in 
races.
